title: The Storybook Dog-eared in Secret
youtube_title: The Storybook Dog-eared in Secret | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: A plain truth is kinder than a tidy secret.
summary: At a workshop bench of wood, glue, and labels, Kira is tangled up with a library book dog-eared in secret and almost hides it. Kira tells Uncle Idris the plain truth, and together they mend what can be mended, with no teasing.
